text: {"summary":"A rollout has been running for 20 minutes without completing, exceeding the default 10‑minute progress deadline.","likely_cause":"The Deployment has exceeded its .spec.progressDeadlineSeconds, causing the Progressing condition to be set to False with reason ProgressDeadlineExceeded, indicating a stalled rollout.","confidence":"high","next_action":"Run `kubectl rollout status deployment/<name>` to confirm the error and see the exit code; describe the Deployment with `kubectl describe deployment <name>` and inspect the Progressing condition and Events for details (e.g., readiness probe failures, image pull errors, quota issues); if the issue is identified, fix the underlying problem (adjust probes, image, permissions, etc.) and resume the rollout; optionally rollback to the previous version using `kubectl rollout undo deployment/<name>` for quick recovery; after fixing, re‑trigger or resume the rollout then verify success with `kubectl rollout status` and `kubectl get deployment <name>`."}
